description: This file defines a Java annotation @HonoTimestamp used for custom serialization and deserialization of Instant objects in JSON using Jackson. It includes custom serializers and deserializers to handle ISO-8601 formatted date-time strings, normalizing date-times to UTC.

classes.name: HonoTimestamp
classes.description: A custom Java annotation for marking Instant fields that require ISO-8601 string serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: Deserializer
classes.description: A Jackson deserializer for ISO-8601 offset date-time strings converting them to Instant objects.

classes.name: Serializer
classes.description: A Jackson serializer converting Instant objects to ISO-8601 string representations.

methods.name: _deserialize
methods.description: Converts an ISO-8601 offset date-time string to an Instant, normalizing to UTC.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes an Instant to an ISO-8601 compliant string in UTC.
